parent: Frozen complete Stage1 39 primary and 16 common inputs, same 944-session native account; SOXX is the final benchmark
single_source: Issuer SOXX Data Download fund.xls, Historical worksheet, NAV per Share and Shares Outstanding. The current workbook is one retrospective 2026-10-22 vintage, not historical first-public receipts.
source_only_candidate_question: SOXX primary-market creation/redemption pressure might distinguish broad persistent weakness from a recoverable price decline beyond the original Stage1 price/breadth/volatility inputs and the closed secondary-market signed-volume route.
illustrative_predecision_formula: At Stage1 signal session t, x_t=log(shares_outstanding_asof(t-2)/shares_outstanding_asof(t-7)); use only exact Qlib trading-session observations, no calendar-day forward fill. Two-session lag is conservative for a prospective design but does not certify historical first publication. No feature values enter a fit or account in this source-only task.
novelty_boundary: Primary-market issuer outstanding shares differ from secondary-market signed volume participation; original Stage1 39 features have no issuer share-count channel. Confirm correlations before an information experiment.
source_gates: Exact unmodified workbook SHA/size and issuer URL/response time
Parse Historical worksheet without changing raw bytes and check schema, duplicate dates, positive NAV/shares
Intersect exact native Qlib 2011-2022 training sessions and 2023-2026 funded signal sessions; preserve weekends but never treat them as trading sessions
Identify restatement/split treatment and historical first-public timing; one current workbook does not certify either
Archive original bytes to Yanxuan NAS and verify remote SHA plus scoped restoration

Compare archived 2021, 2022 and 2023 original issuer workbook shares against the 2026 file after documented 2024 split unit adjustment, recording all overlap and unreadable captures without outcome reads.
stop: Do not fit, read 2023+ outcomes, or run an account until source first-availability and revision/vintage semantics are qualified and a separate matched Stage1 information plan is frozen. Do not infer alpha from coverage.
